sentences.en: Holding on to the rope firmly, I came safely to land.
sentences.zh: 牢牢抓住绳子，我安全地登上了陆地。

sentences.en: This custom has become firmly established among the Japanese.
sentences.zh: 这一习俗在日本已经牢固确立。

sentences.en: I firmly believe it is characteristic of him to be late.
sentences.zh: 我坚定地相信他迟到了是他的特点。

senses.zh: 坚固地;稳固地坚定地;坚决地
